aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab develops practical software for food trucks and mobile catering services: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We develop practical software dedicated to food trucks and mobile catering services, helping them receive online orders, manage collection times, keep orders running smoothly, and spend less time answering repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab came into being to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them was designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: making it easier to run a food truck with tools designed around the way these businesses actually work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover the food trucks visiting their areas, I spent more time learning about the challenges that mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks move constantly, work in different locations, and serve customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Allow customers to order for a later date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically, without needing to confirm each order.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Link the order to the buzzer number when handing it to the customer, so you know which device belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see that shows order numbers and when they become ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your website. Each date links directly to its own order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and it is the only way to keep receiving orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set the quantity your kitchen can prepare at one time and the time it takes. When any slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards that are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combo meals, and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp automatic replies, but for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens, at the front counter and in the kitchen, all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login accounts with the appropriate level of permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: When the signal drops, online ordering pauses so that customers do not send orders you will not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep receiving orders offline, while the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Receive card payment in advance when customers order online, through Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not appear on the map, each with its own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens the menu and the order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your location schedule automatically from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. All you have to do is review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send a text message automatically to customers when their orders become ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs, and we automatically add your dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as 'Sold out' with one tap, and it appears greyed out to customers immediately.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set the stock quantity, and it decreases automatically as orders arrive, then the item is shown as 'Sold out' automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Receive card payments on a supported phone, without needing a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or cable printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose the collection time, so the pressure is spread across the service session.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the serving hatch, with payment through your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service session from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Reply automatically to WhatsApp enquiries about the menu and the location schedule.

landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, a reliable wifi connection and the same working hours every week. You, however, are in a new place every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was designed for exactly this.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering stops automatically so customers cannot send orders you will not see. Keep taking orders through the iPhone, iPad and Android app.

landing.does.title: Designed for food trucks, not for restaurants.

comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is an ordering system for food trucks?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system receives orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or on pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A point-of-sale system or payment device, on the other hand, takes payment at the truck. Each complements the other.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Stripe's fees are also added to online card payments: {cardFee} for each card payment.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum commitment period?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum commitment period and no notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is paid monthly in advance, and your access remains available until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day in which you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent my kitchen from being crowded with orders?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers see only the pickup times your kitchen can actually meet. The system relies on each dish's preparation time and how many of it you prepare at one time.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a point-of-sale system certified under the tax rules?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a point-of-sale system, and is not a sales device certified under the tax rules. As for how to record online orders in your point-of-sale system, consult your tax adviser about it.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card or Apple Pay or Google Pay, or they pay at the truck. Payment via PayPal and Klarna is not available at present.
